meaning: A whole-spec or spec-axis review round's findings, filed as tickets round after round (#4627 §3.1).
A concision pass's ticket on pre-existing text it met while working (#4627 §3.2).
An orphaned-edit ticket: a main-checkout or worktree edit no session claims (#4627 §3.3).
A lander ticket for a queue member it dropped, held or reverted: another ticket's commit did not land (#4627 §3.4).
A defect a session met in passing while working another ticket (#4627 §3.7).
A script-filed standing-condition or due report: morning review, queue wait or stall alarm, release bump, census re-measure, per-file time limit, a review or retro due.
A code-review finding on one ticket's just-built work, filed as its own ticket.
A spec, map, brief, ruling, audit or research question that plans work rather than changing code.
A build slice cut from a spec or a ruling, implementing it.
A re-measurement or reading of a figure after a change landed, or a follow-up to one.
An architecture scan's structural change: one owner or module for a concern several modules share.
A fault in the repo machinery reported off an incident a session met.
A machinery change or defect fix filed outside every labelled flow, its origin read from the title alone.
A host crash, watchdog reset or memory-kill incident on the machine, and its diagnosis.
A change or act the founder asked for directly.
